cases.label: 실제 fetch에서 상품·GET·Accept·credentials·동일 signal을 확인한다
cases.probe: const controller=new AbortController();const calls=[];const client=submission.createProductClient((url,init)=>{calls.push({url,method:init?.method,credentials:init?.credentials,accept:new Headers(init?.headers).get('accept'),sameSignal:init?.signal===controller.signal});return fetch(url,init);});const result=await client.loadProducts('/_fixtures/http/products',{signal:controller.signal});observe({result,calls});

cases.label: 정상 빈 배열을 실패나 가짜 항목으로 바꾸지 않는다
404·503을 HTTP 오류로 반환하고 본문을 소비하지 않는다
cases.probe: let calls=0,reads=0;const client=submission.createProductClient(async(url,init)=>{calls++;const response=await fetch(url,init);return {ok:response.ok,status:response.status,json(){reads++;return response.json();}};});const missing=await client.loadProducts('/_fixtures/http/not-found');const unavailable=await client.loadProducts('/_fixtures/http/unavailable');observe({results:[missing,unavailable],calls,reads});

cases.label: 200 응답의 깨진 JSON을 파싱 실패로 구분한다
JSON은 유효해도 문자열 price인 응답을 거부한다
실제 연결 종료로 생긴 fetch 거부를 HTTP·빈 성공과 구분한다
실제 fetch에 signal을 전달해 취소하고 다음 요청은 정상 처리한다
cases.probe: const controller=new AbortController();const signals=[];const client=submission.createProductClient((url,init)=>{signals.push(init?.signal);return fetch(url,init);});const pending=client.loadProducts('/_fixtures/http/slow',{signal:controller.signal});queueMicrotask(()=>controller.abort({reason:'lesson-cancel'}));const canceled=await pending;const recovered=await client.loadProducts('/_fixtures/http/products');observe({canceled,calls:signals.length,sameSignal:signals[0]===controller.signal,recovered:{ok:recovered.ok,count:recovered.items?.length}});

cases.label: 이미 취소된 요청은 fetch를 시작하지 않는다
실제 본문은 한 번 읽고 반환 항목은 별도 데이터로 만든다
cases.probe: let reads=0;let received;const client=submission.createProductClient(async(url,init)=>{const response=await fetch(url,init);return {ok:response.ok,status:response.status,async json(){reads++;received=await response.json();return received;}};});const result=await client.loadProducts('/_fixtures/http/products');result.items[0].name='Changed';observe({reads,original:received[0].name,returned:result.items[0].name,separateArray:result.items!==received});
